description.value: Big Bend Cafe is a breakfast and lunch spot in downtown Revelstoke, the second location of the original Golden cafe opened in 2017. Known for hearty, home-style cooking with a 60-item menu spanning eggs Benedict, huevos rancheros, specialty burritos, and daily soup specials, it has earned best-breakfast awards in the Kootenay Rockies. Local craft beers, bottomless coffee, and a family-friendly atmosphere make it a popular fuel stop for travelers heading into the mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Revelstoke location of a two-location chain, with address 204 MacKenzie Ave and phone (250) 837-5690 matching OSM. The website explicitly states 'Eat in dining and take out available at both of our locations,' confirming takeout. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (250) 837-5690 was sourced from the website's Revelstoke location listing.
Website covers two locations (Golden and Revelstoke); all details above apply specifically to the Revelstoke location at 204 MacKenzie Ave.
Covid-era notice still present on the website may indicate content is not regularly updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant in downtown Revelstoke with confirmed eat-in and takeout service; hearty breakfast/lunch menu makes it a practical and appealing fuel stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: earned best-breakfast awards in the Kootenay Rockies... hearty, home-style cooking... bottomless coffee
